text.en: Atlas original generic port design study. Metres; schematic compressed layout; 20-foot dry box 6.058 × 2.591 × 2.438 m. Counting: boxes=n20+n40; TEU=n20+2n40. A 32-model-second lift uses source [0,11.2955,-18], destination [0,3.2955,10] and clearance bottom y25. Yard moves=above+1, excluding restoration.
text.zh: Atlas 原创通用港口设计研究。米制压缩示意布局；20 英尺干货箱为 6.058×2.591×2.438 米。箱数=n20+n40，TEU=n20+2n40。32 模型秒吊运从 [0,11.2955,-18] 到 [0,3.2955,10]，抬起时箱底 y25。堆场起吊次数=上方箱数+1，不含复位。

note.en: DESIGN/SIM, not terminal measurements or operating instructions. Rates per resource are crane30, carrier24 and yard18 boxes/h; chain capacity is their minimum. completed=min(arrivals,capacity)×hours; queued=max(0,arrivals−capacity)×hours. Default 1/1/1, arrivals24, hours2 → capacity18, completed36, queued12. 2/1/1 still18; 1/1/2 →24 and queue0. Empty starting queue, continuous flow, no startup or interference. Width is a declared design selection because S9’s HTML table has a 2436/2438 inconsistency. Ropes are straight spans, not real reeving or tension.
note.zh: DESIGN／SIM，不是实测或操作教程。每台岸桥30、车24、场桥18箱/小时，全链取最小值。完成量=min(到达率,能力)×小时；积压=max(0,到达率−能力)×小时。默认1/1/1、到达24、2小时→能力18、完成36、积压12；2/1/1仍18，1/1/2→24且不再积压。初始空队列、连续流，忽略起动和互扰。S9网页有2436／2438不一致，宽度为明确设计选择；直绳不代表真实穿绳或张力。
